text: dsh-lfaa（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：这是一个把小说创作、外观配置和 Minecraft 服务器管理放进 DSH 工作区的插件。它注册主工作区、会话视图、侧栏和设置页，并提供 minecraft_server 工具。主要功能包括按账号本地保存小说章节、通过 DSH 会话生成润色或续写建议、调整主题密度与动效，以及管理 Paper/Fabric 服务器和 Fabric 模组。适合在 DSH 中写作或维护 Minecraft 服务器的用户；Minecraft 功能需要选择本地数据目录，服务目录查询会连接相应官方服务。

dsh-lfaa (DSH web plugin) combines novel writing, appearance controls, and Minecraft management. It adds a workspace and minecraft_server tool. Users can save chapters locally, request DSH writing suggestions, adjust themes, and manage Paper/Fabric servers and mods.
我想在 DSH 里整理小说项目、分卷和章节。
能不能让 DSH 根据当前章节给我润色或续写建议？
我想把写作草稿留在本地，并按账号分别保存。
有没有能在 DSH 里切换界面密度、主题和动效的工作区？
I want to create and organize novels, volumes, and chapters inside DSH.
Can DSH send a chapter to my conversation and return a polish suggestion?
I need a workspace to create and manage a Paper or Fabric Minecraft server.
How can I search for compatible Fabric mods and manage server backups from DSH?
小说工作区：创建和整理小说、分卷与章节，并编辑章节内容；选择章节后自动保存草稿到浏览器本地存储。
写作建议：选择 DSH 会话后提交润色或续写提示，插件将该轮回复作为建议呈现，用户可再决定是否应用。
外观设置：在工作区选择原生、柔和或清晰预设，并调整密度和动效；可按系统减少动态效果偏好投影主题令牌。
Minecraft 管理：通过 minecraft_server 查询版本、创建和安装 Paper/Fabric 实例，查看状态、控制生命周期并读写配置文件。
Fabric 模组与备份：搜索并安装兼容模组，创建、列出和恢复已停止实例的备份；从工作区或 minecraft_server 工具发起操作。
dsh-lfaa 使用前须知：Minecraft 目前仅支持 Paper、Fabric 和 Fabric 模组。（见 packages/dsh-lfaa-minecraft/src/tools.mjs:45）

dsh-lfaa README · dsh-lfaa：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A complete native DSH plugin project with independently owned business modules. Appearance, layout, cards, dialogs and motion are one capability group, not the definition of the whole plugin. This is a new project designed around DSH; it does not copy or migrate the old LFAA project.

dsh-lfaa README · dsh-lfaa：DSH owns accounts, all AI execution, sessions, models, subagents, tool dispatch and approval. The plugin contributes its own business through public interfaces and keeps business data local when needed. No second harness, login or conversation store is introduced.

dsh-lfaa README · dsh-lfaa：The three-column writing workspace manages novel projects and chapters, autosaves the selected chapter, and sends AI polish/continuation prompts through a selected DSH conversation. Results appear as suggestions and are applied only after a user action. Writing data is stored locally under the verified DSH account profile ID.

dsh-lfaa README · Develop：The DSH repository root is also an install facade: its manifest points to the committed `dist/packages/dsh-lfaa/` output, so GitHub installs do not need to run a build lifecycle script. The package ships both root entries and matching `dist/` compatibility entries for older DSH loaders. In DSH's Add Plugin dialog, enter the repository URL `https://github.com/yubboo/dsh-lfaa.git`; for a local install, run `pnpm run build` first and enter this repository's root directory. The GitHub push menu rebuilds the installable output before staging it. The build excludes private workspace dependencies, development source, test fixtures and user data. The package name `dsh-lfaa` works after the built distribution is published to npm. On Windows, run `publish-npm.bat` from the repository root: menu 6 safely pushes to GitHub `main`, requiring a commit message that starts with a new three-part source version; menu 7 builds, previews and publishes to the official npm registry after confirmation, and menus 1–5 provide package checks. dsh-lfaa README · Develop：Minecraft currently supports Paper and Fabric Host services and Agent operations, with a session workspace panel for distribution/version discovery, server create/install, status, start/stop, configuration, file inspection, console commands, backup/restore, and mod search/install. Fabric mods are searched through Modrinth by Minecraft version and installed only into a stopped Fabric instance; required dependencies are resolved recursively and downloaded files are checked against Modrinth SHA-512 metadata. Modpacks, Forge, NeoForge, and end-to-end acceptance in a real DSH Profile remain unfinished. The panel submits explicit requests into the active DSH conversation; the Agent inspects Java and may install an official Temurin runtime when needed, while downloads, writes, and process actions remain subject to DSH approval. The user must explicitly confirm Minecraft EULA acceptance. Paper downloads carry publisher SHA-256 metadata. Fabric's official HTTPS bootstrap endpoint does not publish the same checksum metadata, so the plugin records the downloaded file's local hash and validates its JAR format without claiming publisher-checksum verification.
